title: Glowing trophy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFEE88' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFCC00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE566'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E6A800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldLight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF5B0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cupShade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#E6A800'/>
      <stop offset='30%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFE566'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D4A000'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='36' fill='#FFCC00' opacity='0.12'/>

  <!-- Base platform -->
  <rect x='30' y='82' width='40' height='8' rx='3' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <!-- Base top highlight -->
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='36' height='3' rx='2' fill='#FFF5B0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Base stem/pedestal -->
  <rect x='42' y='72' width='16' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#cupShade)'/>
  <!-- Stem highlight -->
  <rect x='44' y='73' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#FFF5B0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Small connector -->
  <rect x='40' y='68' width='20' height='6' rx='2' fill='url(#gold)'/>

  <!-- Trophy cup body -->
  <path d='M28 20 C28 20 26 50 32 60 C36 67 44 70 50 70 C56 70 64 67 68 60 C74 50 72 20 72 20 Z' fill='url(#cupShade)'/>

  <!-- Cup inner highlight -->
  <path d='M34 24 C34 24 32 46 37 56 C40 62 45 65 50 65 C50 65 44 62 41 55 C36 44 38 24 38 24 Z' fill='#FFF5B0' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- Cup top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#FFE566'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#E6A800'/>

  <!-- Left handle -->
  <path d='M28 26 C14 26 12 44 28 50' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 28 C17 28 16 42 28 47' stroke='#FFF5B0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Right handle -->
  <path d='M72 26 C86 26 88 44 72 50' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 28 C83 28 84 42 72 47' stroke='#FFF5B0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Star on cup -->
  <polygon points='50,33 52.5,40 60,40 54,44.5 56.5,52 50,47.5 43.5,52 46,44.5 40,40 47.5,40' fill='#FFF5B0'/>
  <polygon points='50,36 51.5,41 56,41 52.5,43.8 54,48 50,45.2 46,48 47.5,43.8 44,41 48.5,41' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='15' r='2' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='12' r='2.5' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='60' r='1.8' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFF5B0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#FFF5B0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Tiny sparkle crosses -->
  <path d='M70 10 L70 16 M67 13 L73 13' stroke='#FFEE88' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M18 70 L18 74 M16 72 L20 72' stroke='#FFEE88' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
